bahrain.title: Government steps up housing plans with private developers and new finance schemes
bahrain.summary: Housing Minister Amna Al Romaihi told Parliament that thousands of new homes are planned, with more partnerships with private developers, wider housing finance schemes and redevelopment of former temporary housing sites in Isa Town.

bahrain.title: MPs propose law to regulate instalment sales and protect buyers
bahrain.summary: A bill from five MPs led by Hamad Al Doy would stop sellers cancelling a purchase once a buyer has paid 75% of the price, and would punish unlicensed instalment sellers with jail and fines of up to BD 5,000.

bahrain.title: New building law would fine unauthorised construction up to BD 20,000
bahrain.summary: MPs debate a government-drafted building regulation law on Tuesday that allows fines of up to BD 20,000 and prison for unauthorised building work. Companies could face criminal liability, with corporate fines up to double the normal maximum.

bahrain.title: Bill would reserve mobile food businesses for Bahrainis
bahrain.summary: A proposed law, up for a vote in Parliament on Tuesday, would require mobile food business operators to be Bahraini, bar them from recruiting foreign workers for the activity, and fine unlicensed traders up to BD 5,000.

bahrain.title: Bahrain condemns Houthi strikes on Saudi refinery and ports
bahrain.summary: The Foreign Ministry condemned continued Houthi attacks on Saudi civilian and economic sites, including a strike on the Jazan refinery that killed a Nepali worker, an attack on Jazan port and intercepted attempts near Ras Tanura, Jeddah port and Riyadh, warning of risks to energy supply and shipping.

bahrain.title: EWA running 129 projects to strengthen Capital Governorate power network
bahrain.summary: The Electricity and Water Authority is carrying out 129 projects to reinforce electricity distribution networks in the Capital Governorate. Only 6.2% of the work has been completed so far.

bahrain.title: Decree-law would let municipal councils stay on if Parliament's term is extended
bahrain.summary: MPs debate on Tuesday a royal decree-law allowing the Prime Minister to extend existing municipal councils until the end of an extended parliamentary term, avoiding a legal gap if municipal elections are delayed.

bahrain.title: Cityscape Bahrain shows about $10 billion of property projects
bahrain.summary: The fifth Cityscape Bahrain at Exhibition World in Sakhir is its largest yet, with around $10 billion of projects from more than 40 exhibitors, including the main master developers, and 8,000 to 9,000 visitors expected over five days.

crypto.title: Binance gets preliminary approval for an Asia hub in Bhutan
crypto.summary: The Gelephu Central Bank granted Binance in-principle approval for regulated digital asset operations in Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, which Binance plans to make an Asia hub. It is not yet a full licence, and Binance must still meet the remaining regulatory conditions.

crypto.title: Bitcoin falls below $59,000 while stocks and gold rise
crypto.summary: Bitcoin briefly reached $62,100 on Friday before sellers pushed it to $58,700 at the Wall Street open, with $228 million of crypto positions liquidated in one hour. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq opened higher and gold rose 2%, leaving bitcoin out of step with other assets.

crypto.title: KuCoin to delist Monero ahead of EU privacy coin restrictions
crypto.summary: KuCoin will delist Monero on 30 November and close withdrawals on 31 December, after MEXC dropped it earlier this month. XMR fell 10.5% to about $450. From 10 July 2027 EU rules bar regulated crypto firms from handling anonymity-enhancing coins.

crypto.title: Trump-linked WLFI token falls about 50% to record lows
crypto.summary: The WLFI token, linked to the Trump family's crypto venture, has dropped by roughly half to its lowest level on record, according to a CoinDesk headline.

crypto.title: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN form crypto payments working group
crypto.summary: ASEAN+3 finance officials agreed in Kyoto to set up a working group, overseen by AMRO, to connect national digital payment networks and align regulation. Member states still license crypto firms separately, so regional expansion needs multiple approvals.

crypto.title: Ethereum sets Glamsterdam testnet launch for 15 December
crypto.summary: Ethereum developers scheduled the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet, the last step before mainnet, for 15 December after a delay over gas pricing changes that could break some smart contracts. Mainnet is mid-January at the earliest.
